title: What our customers are saying about Acme
body: Join the increasing number of customers and advocates who rely on Acme for seamless and effective user A/B testing.

hero.boldHead: Prime implemented our streaming optimization suite to
hero.tail: reduce buffering by 62% during peak viewing hours.
hero.quote: Using Acme has been like unlocking a secret design superpower. It's the perfect fusion of simplicity and versatility, enabling us to create UIs that are as stunning as they are user-friendly.
hero.name: Shadcn
